artist.name: EBITDA
artist.bio: EBITDA is an Indian DJ, rooted in Kolkata, who played clubs in Delhi and Bangalore before moving to the UK, where he is resident at Simple in Oxford. His sets cover electro, breaks, IDM, techno, drum and bass and acid, and he has closed for Joy Orbison.

eras.sound: Raw, wonky leftfield club across shifting rhythms
